Image generation requesting multiple images with n=3

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import CreateImageRequest

async def main() -> None:
    client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
    req = CreateImageRequest.from_json("{\"model\":\"dall-e-3\",\"n\":3,\"prompt\":\"A cat\"}")
    result = await client.image_generate(req)
    print(result.data)
    print(result.data[0].url)
    print(result.data[1].url)
    print(result.data[2].url)

asyncio.run(main())
```
